interpretation: Three new namespaces retain the same original fixed sample and scientific bytes. Ranks/stages are nested in verification; append parts conserve raw cost, including observer overhead. Refinements are frozen before timing, use structural rows only, and explicitly expose unsampled cells. Parent fallback fills only a conditional sensitivity scenario, never evidence for unsampled cells. Repeats/cache/system states are uncontrolled. No causal speedup, runtime bound or full T_plan.
privacy: Keys, ordinal rosters, per-query timings/effects and model contents remain ignored. Only aggregate workload/cost/coverage and artifact descriptors are published.

refinement_sensitivity.projection: Population times observed sample maximum; uncovered cells explicitly borrow parent maximum. Component maxima may occur on different queries and must not be added.
